sentences.text:
Author: Soumen Sen Bench: Soumen Sen  12.08.2024  Sl No.26  Court No. 29  TN  (Allowed)
 CRM (A) 2739 of 2024  In Re:- An application for anticipatory bail under Sec  the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, corresponding to  482 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 fi  connection with Hariharpara Police Station Case No.564  dated 19.12.2023 under Sections 498A/328/307/506/34 of  Indian Penal Code, Section 4 of the DP Act with adding  304B of IPC.
 And  In the matter of : Akali Sk. @ Akali Mondal  .
 Mr. Jisan Iqubal Hossain  ....for  Mr. Imran Ali,
 Mr. Soumya Basu Roy Chowdhuri  ...

1.
Claiming parity with Monirul Sk. @ Manirul Islam who was granted anticipatory bail by a coordinate Bench on 11th March, 2024 in CRM (A) 825 of 2024 not being opposed by the State, we are inclined to grant anticipatory bail to the petitioner.

2. Accordingly, we direct that in the event of arrest, the petitioner, namely, Akali Sk. @ Akali Mondal shall be released on bail upon furnishing a bond of Rs.10,000/-, with two sureties of like amount each, one of whom must be local, to the satisfaction of the arresting officer and also subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973,
corresponding to Section 482(2) of the BNSS, 2023 and on further condition that the petitioner will report before the Investigating Officer once in a week till the conclusion of investigation and on condition that the Signed By :
TANMOY NANDAN High Court of Calcutta 13 th of August 2024 11:29:14 AM petitioner shall appear on every date before the jurisdictional Court on and from the Akali Sk.

@ Akali Mondal vs Unknown on 12 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/166651520/
1 date fixed for appearance of the accused and in default the jurisdictional Court will pass appropriate order to secure the presence of the petitioner in Court including cancelling the anticipatory bail granted without further reference to this Court.
3. Accordingly, the application for anticipatory bail is disposed of.
4. All parties shall act on the server copy of this order duly downloaded from the official website of this Court.

(Soumen Sen, J.) (Uday Kumar, J.) Signed By :
TANMOY NANDAN High Court of Calcutta 13 th of August 2024 11:29:14 AM Akali Sk. @ Akali Mondal vs Unknown on 12 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/166651520/
2
